name: Email (simulation)
description: Simulated inbox for testing an agent's email replies — nothing leaves the laptop

fields.label: Mode (optional)
fields.placeholder: simulation (default) — live needs a mailbox adapter

templates.name: Work the inbox
templates.description: Read the simulated inbox and send replies. Cannot load or replace test data.
templates.intent: Allow the agent to read the simulated inbox and reply to messages on its own. It cannot load or replace the test data the inbox was seeded with.

templates.name: Load test data (with approval)
templates.description: Load a simulation package into an empty inbox. No reading or sending — a separate, one-time setup mandate.
templates.intent: Allow the agent to load one simulation package into an empty inbox, with my review before it happens. No reading or sending under this mandate — grant it separately from the mandate the agent uses for its daily work.

setupHint: No configuration needed — works out of the box, in simulation mode.

setupGuide.title: Ready to use
setupGuide.description: This connector stores a simulated inbox locally on your machine. Nothing is sent anywhere until you load test data with a separate, reviewed setup mandate.

setupGuide.title: Optional: use a shared database
setupGuide.description: For team use, provide a PostgreSQL connection string in the Database URL field. Otherwise, leave it empty to use local SQLite storage.
